text:
I can certainly help you add a 30-minute walk to your schedule.

I see that on Wednesday, your "Work" block finishes at 4:00 PM, and right after that, your "Community Time" block is scheduled from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM. Adding a walk at 4:00 PM would overlap with your community engagement.

Would you like to shorten your "Community Time" block on Wednesday to 4:30 PM to make room for the walk, or would you prefer to place the walk during another free slot, like between 7:00 AM and 9:00 AM on Wednesday?
